svg.title: The Ambassador journal
svg.desc: The ambassador records its intent, then sends the courier's system a command with a stable operation id. When no answer comes, the outcome is unknown and the resource stays held. The ambassador then asks, sends the same id again, or stops by the declared delivery class, and records the outcome. Record intent first: 1. Ambassador calls Journal: intent + operation id. 2. Journal replies to Ambassador: recorded. Act: 3. Ambassador calls Courier system: command + operation id. If answer arrives: 4a. Courier system replies to Ambassador: result. If no answer: 4b. Ambassador sends to Ambassador: timeout = unknown, resource held, refused. Settle by delivery class: If verify: 5a. Ambassador calls Courier system: did you receive it. 6a. Courier system replies to Ambassador: yes or no. If resend: 5b. Ambassador calls Courier system: same operation id. 6b. Courier system replies to Ambassador: result. Otherwise: 5c. Ambassador sends to Ambassador: stays unknown, owner settles, refused. Close: 7. Ambassador sends to Journal: record outcome.
